propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate recruited underwriters and relationship managers as participants and maintained the participant and consent records in the research repository.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the recruitment and records directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate coordinated research logistics with compliance and the business units and recorded who owned availability, scheduling and consent.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the coordination and the recorded boundaries.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate owned the research operations programme, held the delegated compliance sign-off on research plans and led the quarterly planning session.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the delegation record, the signed plan and the reference state the ownership, the sign-off delegation and the session leadership.

expectedGap: Hand-over conditions for each research round are only partly documented in the planning notes.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the ownership as documented: programme ownership and plan sign-off under the recorded delegation; do not extend it to compliance policy itself.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask how hand-over conditions were recorded for each research round.
